story.title: This Cloud Monster Snaps Its Prey Mid-Air
story.signature_move: It hovers on vibrating wings before snapping its armored claws shut around passing prey in a flash.
story.hybrid_look: A massive, terrifying apex predator with a menacing, armored face, glowing crimson eyes, jagged shell spikes, and razor-sharp hummingbird needle fangs.

sentences.text: This impossible monster destroys its victims without ever touching the ground.
sentences.image: dense, swirling sulfuric acid clouds lit by flashes of violet lightning across a dark sky

sentences.text: Meet the hummingcrab, a terrifying imaginary hybrid born from the armor of a crab and the wings of a hummingbird.
sentences.image: thick, glowing amber fog rolling heavily over a crushing atmospheric pressure gradient

sentences.text: It survives the scorching heat of Venus by using a reflective shell that bounces away thermal radiation.
sentences.image: blinding white glare reflecting off toxic cloud layers under a pale yellowish sun

sentences.text: To fight the violent atmospheric winds, it rapidly flaps its wings to hover in place just like real hummingbirds do.
sentences.image: turbulent, swirling vortexes of dark crimson vapor twisting through the high atmosphere

sentences.text: It hovers on vibrating wings before snapping its armored claws shut around passing prey in a flash.
sentences.image: deep cloud canyons plunging into pitch blackness where high speed gales roar continuously

sentences.text: Its heavy exoskeleton protects it from corrosive acid rain that would instantly melt softer creatures.
sentences.image: heavy, dripping mist of yellow chemical fluid falling through a gloomy, overcast sky

sentences.text: Despite its fierce dominance, it completely freezes and drops like a stone if exposed to sudden freezing drafts. What should I combine next? Tell me in the comments.
